{{Quote|We count thirty Rebel ships, Lord Vader, but they're so small they're evading our turbolasers.|Lieutenant Tanbris, during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]|<ref name="ANH" />}}
'''Tanbris''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A capable [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], he reached the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], but was grounded after an injury. By [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Tanbris was a [[Tactical officer/Legends|tactical officer]] aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] as part of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] personal crew. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] that same [[Standard year/Legends|year]] when the Death Star was [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destroyed]] by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], a pilot of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|We'll have to destroy them ship to ship. Get the crews to their fighters.|Darth Vader to Lt. Tanbris|<ref name="ANH" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Tanbris joined the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]],<ref name="ANH" /> the armed forces of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|New Order]],<ref name="IS">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> in which he became a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and attained the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]].<ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> At some point during his Imperial service, Tanbris came to work with [[Thul Fain]], who later left the Empire and became a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=Thul Fain}}</ref> Tanbris' promising career as a fighter pilot was ruined when he was injured. Following the accident, he was grounded and got reoriented, becoming a [[Tactical officer/Legends|tactical officer]].<ref name="BTM" />

By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Lieutenant Tanbris served aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]], a deep-[[Realspace/Legends|space]] mobile [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] built by the Empire to destroy entire [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] with a single [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] shot. He was made a crew [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the Emperor's right-hand man [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], answering directly to his orders. When the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] launched an attack on the station, Tanbris rushed to [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader in the corridor of the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star's]] command center, informing him that the enemy [[Starship/Legends|ships]] were too small to be shot down by the [[Meridian trench/Legends|meridian trench's]] turbolaser towers. After being so ordered by Vader, the lieutenant had [[Black Squadron (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Black Squadron]], a unit of elite fliers, get to their fighters so they could shoot the Rebels one by one.<ref name="DS">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref> A few moments later, the Rebel pilot [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] fired [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] in the the trench's [[Thermal exhaust port/Legends|exhaust vent]], triggering a chain reaction that propagated to the Death Star's core. The battlestation exploded,<ref name="ANH" /> and Tanbris was among those [[Death/Legends|killed]] from the explosion.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Personality and traits==
Throughout his military career, Tanbris had emerged as a capable pilot and skilled officer.<ref name="BTM" /> He had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="ANH" />

==Equipment==
While serving aboard the Death Star, Tanbris wore the black variant of the [[Imperial officer's uniform/Legends|Imperial officer's uniform]].<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Tanbris-comics.png|thumb|right|200px|Lieutenant Tanbris in the 1977 Marvel comics adaptation]]
Tanbris first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], the first movie of the ''Star Wars'' [[original trilogy]].<ref name="ANH" /> Although he was not credited, stuntman [[Andy Bradford]] played the character according to the fan website [http://www.starwarsautographcollecting.com Dahoov's Autograph Collecting].<ref>{{WebCite|url=http://starwarsautographcollecting.com/Autographs/StarWarsTrilogy/ANewHope/AndyBradford.htm|text=Andy Bradford|work=Dahoov's Autograph Collecting|archivedate=20190427160957}}</ref> The lieutenant went unnamed in the film itself<ref name="ANH" /> and was referred to as one Vader's "astro-officers" in the script.<ref name="BTM" /><ref name="Art of Star Wars">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope]]''</ref><ref name="Annotated">''[[Star Wars: The Annotated Screenplays]]''</ref> Tanbris was first identified in the ''[[Premiere Limited]]'' set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="CCG2">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Lieutenant Tanbris}}</ref>

Tanbris was present in most adaptations of ''Star Wars Episode IV'', including the 1977 [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]]&mdash;in which he was referred to as a "a harried [[Commander/Legends|Commander]]"&mdash;<ref name="ANHN">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novel]]</ref> and [[Marvel Comics|Marvel]] [[Star Wars (1977) 6|comic book]],<ref name="MSW6">[[Star Wars (1977) 6|''Star Wars'' (1977) 6]]</ref> as well as the [[1997]] [[Star Wars: A New Hope - The Special Edition 4|adaptation]] by [[Dark Horse Comics]].<ref name="DHSW">[[Star Wars: A New Hope - The Special Edition 4|''Star Wars: A New Hope - The Special Edition'' 4]]</ref> In the 1977 comic book, the lieutenant was depicted with blond hair and wearing an olive green tunic with a tan officer cap.<ref name="MSW6" />

A string in ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]'' has TEXT_UNIT_TIE_TANBRIS as the string's name, with TIE Advanced X-2 as the data in the string; however no unit uses this string, and there is no TEXT_TOOLTIP string to go with it as its description as there is for all other units. This suggests that Tanbris was to pilot a [[TIE/x2 starfighter|TIE Advanced x2]] starfighter in the game, but was canceled early on, and its name string was left in.<ref name="SW:EAW">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''</ref>

In [[2008]], Tanbris received his own entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="CSWE" /> He was also mentioned in Thul Fain's entry, although oddly misspelled as "Trabinis."<ref name="CSWEThul">{{CSWECite|I|251|Fain, Thul}}</ref>
